scope: Zero-model admission of the frozen gpt-5.6-sol/high native Codex backend; no business task was started.

decision.technical_interpretation: The full named permission profile is operationally unusable on this Windows native route. The bounded comparison associates the delay with the full permission expression and named-profile initialization path; it does not distinguish leaf count, the 1,119 exact-write rules, write semantics, or named-versus-inline loading.
decision.why: 为什么要有它：权限反例通过不能抵消分钟级启动，收窄配置变快也不能直接授权使用更小权限集合。

next_experiment.expected_effect: Separate named-profile loading, permission leaf count, and exact-write semantics while preserving the same allowed files and denied effects for every causal comparison.
next_experiment.comparison_baseline: The current named 1,204-leaf profile has a 172.172-second plan-bound first output and three 35-second timeouts; the inline 85-leaf profile returns in 0.469 seconds but changes both authority and loading form.
next_experiment.verification: First compare named and inline loading with one authority-equivalent table where the supported command length permits it. Then compare supported alternative shapes with identical exact-file write authority, run the same permission counterexamples, and measure three cmd starts per profile. If no authority-equivalent representation meets the limit, evaluate a two-phase native route: read-only investigation followed by a separately bound small write set and exact source preimages.
next_experiment.stop_condition: Do not start a business task until one authority-equivalent profile passes all permission counterexamples and the 15-second median/30-second maximum startup contract.
next_experiment.why: 为什么要有它：下一步必须改变被证据指向的权限技术路线，同时继续保持源码写入范围可核验。
